This scene:
古代的时候，一个男孩子跟他的妈妈住在中国。他叫孟子。他们住在墓地的旁边，所以孟子老是祭拜。孟子不是祭拜，就是跟朋友聊天。他很喜欢他的城市，但是城市有才两个学校，都很小。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 古代的时候：在古代
- 但是城市有才两个学校：这个城市，只有

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，The time word and the following time phrase repeat the same meaning; use the shorter time expression. [vocab list]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 城市有才两个学校：城市里才有两个学校，In an existential sentence, the limiting adverb must come before the verb, so use the order “才有”; “城里” gives the location naturally. [rule: none]
3. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 一个男孩子跟他的妈妈住在中国。他叫孟子：有一个叫孟子的男孩子和他的妈妈住在中国，On first mention, introduce the main character with both his name and a full noun phrase instead of naming him only after a pronoun. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 他的城市：自己的城市，When the subject and the possessor are the same person, this form makes that relationship clear and avoids suggesting that the city belongs to another male person. [teacher rule: ziji_possessor]

items.reason: 古代 already expresses a time period, so 古代的时候 is redundant under the teacher's rule.
有才 has incorrect ordering, and the teacher's standard requires 只有 rather than 才有 here.
一个男孩子 followed immediately by 他叫孟子 introduces the character clearly and does not violate the reference rule.
他的城市 clearly refers back to the immediately preceding subject, so 自己的 is optional rather than required.
